channel.title: M1S0 — Security Researcher
channel.description: Writeups on vulnerability research, exploitation, and smart contract auditing.

item.title: Unauthenticated SSRF in a WordPress plugin import endpoint
item.description: An import handler that never checked who was calling it, and happily fetched any URL I handed over.

item.title: One future-dated oracle round froze an entire vault
item.description: A timestamp subtraction nobody thought twice about, and the unsigned integer underflow that turned it into a denial of service.

item.title: How I actually read a smart contract for the first time
item.description: Not line by line from the top. Here is the order I go in, and why invariants come before implementation.
